claim: Given a list of work items (id, work type, benchmark role, frontier class, new-primitive claim with its proof fields, load-bearing obligation references, exact non-negative leverage and cost numbers) and the number of open checkpoint obligations, rank_work returns every item exactly once, ordered by: eligible work before demoted work; then exact-fraction leverage score (capability + efficiency + reliability) x reuse breadth x generalization x success probability / (wall + compute + memory + complexity cost), descending; then checkpoint audit score (discharge + unlock) x success / wall, which is non-zero only while obligations are open and the item references one; then work id. Benchmark instrumentation without an allowed role, new-primitive claims whose six proof requirements are not all present, and open-world evidence frontier work without a concrete counterexample or verified defect are demoted with score 0. Inputs with an unknown work type, duplicate ids, negative numbers, success probability above 1 or zero total cost on eligible work are refused. The result is planning only: no execution authority and zero acceptance, capability, ownership and terminal credit.
input_class: 2-9 items; scores from a small pool, 35 % of items exact leverage twins of an earlier item and 15 % with zero expected gain, so exact ties (including eligible work scored 0 next to demoted work) are common; ints and decimal strings mixed; 30 % zero open obligations; 25 % open-world frontier items (half with a concrete defect id); 25 % new-primitive claims (half with one proof requirement missing, blank or lacking a mechanism reason); 35 % load-bearing references; benchmark items with allowed or disallowed roles; 15 % of instances carry exactly one defect (duplicate id, unknown work type, negative number, success > 1, zero cost) placed on an item that is certainly eligible.
scope_limits: NO shared-residual fan-out tie-break: items never carry shared_residual_cause_ids, so the repository residual ledger is never read
NO live authority reading: checkpoint_open_obligation_count is always supplied; rank_live_work and the current-authority file are out of scope
NO validation of malformed id lists or non-string identifiers beyond what the generator emits

solver.note: the kernel is byte-pinned by governance records, so the pure adapter lives in a separate module; the receipt records the kernel blob too

declared.lineage: exact-fraction re-computation of the published score and sort order with the fractions module; no scheduler code

falsification_condition: Any generated work list on which the returned order, eligibility label or exact score differs from the contract, a demoted item outranks an eligible one, input order or uniform cost scaling changes the order, a defective input is accepted, or any authority or credit field is non-zero.
history: Component named by the audit under 'Authenticated / capability-first schedulers'; previously covered only by hand-written example tests. First fresh-instance measurement 2026-10-14.
